test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 1) Mid-Range Full Test - 01
subject: general
question: Umesh is standing facing the south-west direction. He then takes a 90° clockwise turn. After that, he takes a 135° clockwise turn. He finally takes a 90° anticlockwise turn. In which direction is he facing now?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) Umesh is standing facing the south-west direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3620f948459a3ada8a6abe306be68fb9973cc8803ac7d83b44da1ca910dcedd.png] 

2) He then takes a 90° clockwise turn.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/acf9ff378180c4e8155ca379da86e2a7dd93b39a88c5259b5ed0ee2d7983ba4b.png] 

3) After that, he takes a 135° clockwise turn.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a95ecdf944a86909fc86ae0ba93838fbf5132085d5af070e552bdbc8e8acda7e.png] 

4) He finally takes a 90° anticlockwise turn.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5254bdb95651d059725d2f63d7c4c79e85647c140acbf4d300dfa75a78a6ae2.png] 

Here, we can see that Umesh is now facing North direction.

Hence, the correct answer is **"North"**.
